primary_relation_metrics.atom_relation_accuracy: share of atom decisions where relation equals expected
primary_relation_metrics.macro_f1: macro average F1 over ENTAILS, CONTRADICTS, PARTIAL, RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT, AMBIGUOUS, UNRELATED

diagnostic_metrics.BOUNDARY_INFORMATION_COLLAPSE_RATE: share of relation errors where the final boundary 3-state alone does not separate two or more semantically distinct dimension patterns; measured by grouping errors by (boundary overall, blocking_dimensions) and counting groups containing >=2 distinct expected dimension patterns / total errors
